name: BSP_Timestamp_Subtract
evidence: ECX left, stack destination/right, EAX destination, RET8. Equal frequency subtracts ticks modulo2^64; unequal rescales right via low64 multiplication and signed magnitude division before subtracting. Left frequency retained.
